findings.evidence: skills/skill-router/references/routing-table.md:1-9 self-describes as 'a generated artefact' that 'must be regenerated after description changes'; no generator script exists anywhere under scripts/ or skills/skill-router/ (grep found none). findings.fix: Rename the 7 frontmatter `name` values to match their directories; fix skill-builder/SKILL.md's own authoring guidance to match the ruflo/agentskills.io convention instead of contradicting it

lint_extensions.name: name-equals-dir
lint_extensions.rule: frontmatter `name` must match /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/ AND equal the skill's directory basename

lint_extensions.name: registered-entries-resolve
lint_extensions.rule: every non-comment line in registered-skills.txt must have a matching skills/<name>/SKILL.md, AND (new) its manifest gate in agentbox.toml (if any) must not be explicitly false

lint_extensions.name: directory-coverage
lint_extensions.rule: every skillEntries() name must appear as a word-boundary match in skills/SKILL-DIRECTORY.md (same technique as tests/integration/skill-router-fixture.test.mjs assertion 3)

lint_extensions.name: description-length
lint_extensions.rule: frontmatter `description` length must satisfy 40 <= len <= 1024 (agentskills.io cap; floor catches vague one-liners)

lint_extensions.name: deprecated-stub-keys
lint_extensions.rule: a SKILL.md whose skill name appears in SKILL-DIRECTORY.md's Deprecated table must itself carry frontmatter keys `deprecated: true` and `replacement: <name>`

lint_extensions.name: known-key-allowlist
lint_extensions.rule: flag any top-level frontmatter key not in an allowlist (name, description, version, license, allowed-tools, compatibility, metadata, + the estate's own honoured set); direct new estate-private keys under metadata:

lint_extensions.name: cross-skill-ref-resolve
lint_extensions.rule: extend citedResources()'s RESOURCE_ROOTS check to also resolve a backtick path of the form `other-skill-name/references/...` against ../other-skill-name/references/...

lint_extensions.name: stale-model-id
lint_extensions.rule: regex /Opus 4\.|Sonnet 4\.|GPT-5\.|gpt-4o|\bo3\b/ as a CURRENT-model claim, reusing lint-skills.mjs's existing STALE_CONTEXT_SUPPRESS idiom (DEAD|retired|legacy|deprecated|historical) for historical-context suppression

codex_parity: GPT-6 Astra has no discovery layer at all today, only a historical accident: two hand-symlinked skills (codebase-video, repo-education) in ~/.codex/skills pointing at the live workspace source tree rather than the baked /opt/agentbox/skills tree Claude's reconcile-skills.sh uses, so a rebuild can silently desync them from what Claude sees. scripts/reconcile-skills.sh is Claude-only by construction (default CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR=$HOME/.claude/skills) and config/entrypoint-unified.sh invokes it exactly once, targeting only Claude (lines 2267-2274); the separate AGENTS.md write at lines 2119-2138 is unrelated — it documents RuVector MCP memory tools, never skills, SKILL-DIRECTORY.md, or /route. The minimal parity fix is two independent, additive pieces: (1) a second manifest file, skills/registered-skills-codex.txt (start with the same 20, or a Codex-appropriate subset given it lacks Claude-only affordances — no Agent/fork/Artifact/Skill tool, no /route, no claude-flow hooks — several always-loaded skills like skill-router and codebase-video's forking workflow may not translate), reconciled at boot by a Codex-side sibling of reconcile-skills.sh into ~/.codex/skills the same way, sourced from the same baked tree; (2) a short pointer appended to ~/.codex/AGENTS.md's heredoc in entrypoint-unified.sh directing Codex to skills/SKILL-DIRECTORY.md for the other 108+ reference-only skills, since Codex has no /route slash command and no Skill tool to browse them interactively otherwise. Both are additive manifest/config changes, not implemented here per the read-only constraint.
